arabic text: ABBAS TERE DAR SA DUNIYA MAI DAR KAHA\nJUKTE HAI JAHA SHAH BHI TERA WO ASTAAN
english translation text: WHERE EVEN KINGS BOW THEIR HEADS, SUCH IS YOUR SHRINE

arabic text: ABBAS TERE DAR SA DUNIYA MAI DAR KAHA
english translation text: O ABBAS, WHERE IS A DOOR SUCH AS YOURS IN THE ENTIRE WORLD?

arabic text: TU QAMARE BANI HASHIM ZAHRA KI TU DUA HAI
english translation text: YOU ARE THE MOON OF BANI HASHIM, THE DUA OF BIBI ZAHRA (A.S)

arabic text: SAYA TERE ALAM KA DO JAG PE BA KHUDA HAI
english translation text: BY GOD, YOUR FLAG PROVIDES SHADE TO THE ENTIRE UNIVERSE

arabic text: TERE ALAM KO CHUMNE JUKTA HAI ASMAAN
english translation text: EVEN THE SKY BOWS DOWN TO KISS YOUR FLAG

arabic text: SHERE KHUDA HAI BABA SHERE KARBALA TU
english translation text: YOUR FATHER IS THE LION OF GOD, AND YOU ARE THE LION OF KARBALA

arabic text: TERE DAR PE JO BHI AAYE MUSHKIL KARE KUSHA TU
english translation text: WHOEVER COMES TO YOUR DOOR, YOU FULFILL THEIR WISHES

arabic text: TERE DIYE JALATA HAI IS LIYE JAHAN
english translation text: THAT’S THE REASON WHY THE WORLD LIGHTS CANDLES (IN YOUR REMEMBRANCE)

arabic text: TU SHAHENSHAH HAI AQA DO JAG ME TERI SHAHI
english translation text: YOU ARE THE KING AND YOUR KINGDOM SPREADS ACROSS THE UNIVERSE

arabic text: PANJTAN HAI TUJ PE NAZAA AISI WAFAA NIBHAI
english translation text: THE PANJETAN ARE PROUD OF YOU, SUCH WAS YOUR LOYALTY

arabic text: SHAHID TERE ALAM PAR PANJTAN KA YE NISHAN
english translation text: PROBABLY THIS IS WHY THERE IS SYMBOL OF PANJETAN ON YOUR FLAG

arabic text: JO BHI KHUDA SE MAANGA TERE ALAM SE PAAYA
english translation text: WHATEVER WE ASKED GOD, WE RECEIVED IT THROUGH (THE INTERCESSION) OF YOUR FLAG

arabic text: TERE ALAM KA SAYA HAI KIBRIYA KA SAYA
english translation text: THE SHADE OF YOUR FLAG IS LIKE THE AUTHORITY OF THE ALMIGHTY

arabic text: KYU NA TERE ALAM PE AAKAR KAHE JAHAA'N
english translation text: WHY SHOULD THE WORLD NOT COME TO SAY THIS ON YOUR FLAG…?

arabic text: JO HAI SHABBIR KI QUWAT, ALI KO NAAZ HAI JIS PER\nJISSE ZAHRA KAHE BETA USSE ABBAS KEHTE HAI
english translation text: HE WHO IS THE STRENGTH OF SHABBIR, AND IS A SOURCE OF PRIDE FOR ALI\nHE IS THE ONE WHO ZAHRA CALLS HER SON, HE IS KNOWN AS ABBAS

arabic text: WAFA JIS KA PARHE KALMA USSE ABBAS KEHTE HAI\nJISE SAJDAIN KARE SAJDA USSE ABBAS KEHTE HAI
english translation text: FOR WHOM LOYALTY ITSELF SINGS PRAISES, HE IS KNOWN AS ABBAS\nFOR WHOM PROSTRATION ITSELF PROSTRATES, HE IS KNOWN AS ABBAS

arabic text: JHUKTE HAI JAHAA SHAH BHI TERA WO AASTA\nABBAS TERE DAR SA DUNIYA ME DAR KAHAA'N
english translation text: THIS IS A PLACE WHERE ALL KINGS BOW\nLIKE YOUR DOOR ABBAS, IN THIS WORLD THERE IS NO OTHER DOOR

arabic text: TU QAMRE BANI HASHIM ZAHRA KI TU DUA HAI\nSAYA TERE ALAM KA DO JAG PE BAKHUDA HAI
english translation text: YOU ARE THE MOON OF THE HASHEMITE, YOU ARE THE DUA OF ZAHRA\nTHE SHADE OF YOUR FLAG BY GOD, SHADOWS THE WORLD TOO

arabic text: MUSHKIL KUSHA ALI HAI MUSHKIL KUSHA HAI TU BHI\nWO DAST E KIBRIYA HAI RABBE WAFA HAI TU BHI
english translation text: HE IS THE MIGHT OF GOD, YOU ARE THE GOD OF LOYALTY\nALI IS ONE WHO CAN EASE DIFFICULTY, AND YOU ARE THE SAME

arabic text: PADHTE HAI ALI WALEY YE HI MANQABAT YAHA
english translation text: ADHERENTS OF ALI, IN THIS HYMN ACCLAIM…\nABBAS TERE DAR SA DUNIYA ME DAR KAHAA'N LIKE YOUR DOOR ABBAS, IN THIS WORLD THERE IS NO OTHER DOOR

arabic text: RAUZE PE TERE AAKE EHSAAS YE HUA HAI\nYE GHAR HAI PANJETAN KA IS GHARME HI KHUDA HAI
english translation text: AT YOUR SHRINE INDEED THESE FEELINGS PERSIST\nTHIS IS THE HOUSE OF THE PANJATAN, GOD IS PRESENT HERE

arabic text: SAJDE ME GIRGAYA MAI DEKAR YAHI BAYAA'N
english translation text: IN SAJDA I FELL, AFTER THIS TESTIMONY I GAVE…\nABBAS TERE DAR SA DUNIYA ME DAR KAHAA'N LIKE YOUR DOOR ABBAS, IN THIS WORLD THERE IS NO OTHER DOOR

arabic text: BEDAST IS SAKHI KE DAR PAR JABEE'N JHUKALO
english translation text: DAR DAR BHATAKNE WALO EK BAAT MERI MAANO THOSE KNOCKING AT ALL DOORS, LISTEN TO ME\nAT THE DOOR OF THIS GENEROUS MAN (WITH NO HANDS), BOW YOUR FOREHEAD

arabic text: BE-SAAKHTA KAHOGE KHOLOGE JAB ZABAA'N
english translation text: OUTRIGHT YOU SHALL SAY WHEN YOU INTEND TO SPEAK…\nABBAS TERE DAR SA DUNIYA ME DAR KAHAA'N LIKE YOUR DOOR ABBAS, IN THIS WORLD THERE IS NO OTHER DOOR
